ingredients_exact: 1 cup trail mix (I prefer raisins, cranberries, almonds, pumpkin seeds, papaya, pineapple, and coconut flakes)
instructions_exact: At home, in a Stasher bag, combine oats, trail mix, cinnamon, and brown sugar.
On the trail, bring 1 cup of water to a boil and add the pre-packed ingredients.
Boil for approximately 5 to 10 minutes, or until desired thickness is achieved.
